title: Hack Back Meetings
coreMove: Require a meeting to state the decision, preparation, and time claim before it consumes shared attention.
sourcePressure: The chapter treats meetings as synchronous claims on time that must earn their place through coordination design and clear purpose.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would mock meetings or advise fewer meetings without showing how a useful meeting earns its cost.

hook: Hack Back Meetings as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: regional theater board deciding emergency roof repairs
exampleSpecs.audience: board chair facing a vague meeting request
exampleSpecs.stakes: donor funds and rehearsal safety depend on a real decision
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she refuses the calendar hold until the invite names the roof decision and attaches the contractor photos
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A roof-leak photo packet sits beside a draft board agenda.

exampleSpecs.domain: brewery quality team reviewing a sour batch
exampleSpecs.audience: quality lead deciding whether people need a room or a shared note
exampleSpecs.stakes: a recall choice requires live judgment, but updates do not
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he splits lab updates into a memo and keeps the meeting only for the dump-or-sell decision
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A pH strip dries beside a batch-retention sample.

exampleSpecs.domain: city library renovation team aligning on children's wing fixtures
exampleSpecs.audience: project manager whose standing meeting has become habit
exampleSpecs.stakes: procurement deadlines need one fixture choice, not status recitation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, everyone reports; after, the meeting opens with three fixture samples and a vote threshold
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A carpet tile sample lies beside a fixture bid sheet.

exampleSpecs.domain: satellite operations crew planning a maneuver review
exampleSpecs.stakes: a bad meeting can crowd out simulation while a good one catches risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she asks for the maneuver anomaly question in the invite before accepting the live review
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An orbital plot is clipped beneath a maneuver checklist.

exampleSpecs.domain: regional food pantry coordinating holiday distribution
exampleSpecs.audience: logistics lead with too many update meetings
exampleSpecs.stakes: families wait longer if volunteers trade reports instead of choices
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he turns the meeting into three routing decisions and sends warehouse counts beforehand
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A pallet count sheet rests beside a route-zone magnet.

exampleSpecs.domain: industrial design firm choosing a prototype material
exampleSpecs.audience: designer receiving a meeting invite with no decision owner
exampleSpecs.stakes: prototype week collapses if the room debates undefined preferences
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she asks the requester to name the material decision and bring two tested samples
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A polymer swatch ring sits beside a prototype stress chart.

skillTargets: identify when a scenario calls for: Require a meeting to state the decision, preparation, and time claim before it consumes shared attention.

tryThisNowSpec: For one upcoming meeting, write the decision it must produce and the item each person must read before it starts.
